en: View from above of a huge orderly desert camp: one beautiful holy tent with a courtyard fence of white curtains exactly in the center, and around it on all four sides neat groups of small tents, each group with its own tall banner of a different plain color with no symbols, tiny people between the tents.
caption: המשכן באמצע וכל שבט עם דגלו

en: Inside a holy tent, three priests in white robes and white turbans spreading large blue and red cloths over golden holy objects: a golden seven-branched lamp stand half covered with a blue cloth, a golden table being wrapped in a red cloth. Soft light.
caption: הכהנים מכסים את כלי המשכן

en: Strong Hebrew men with beards taking apart a holy tent in the desert: some rolling up big embroidered curtains, others carefully lowering tall golden wooden boards and pulling silver sockets out of the sand, poles and ropes lying around. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: הלוים מפרקים את המשכן

en: Hebrew men with beards walking in the desert carrying holy objects on their shoulders with long golden poles: in front four men carrying a chest completely covered with a blue cloth, behind them men carrying other objects wrapped in blue and red cloths. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: בני קהת נושאים את הכלים על הכתף

en: A very long orderly procession of Hebrew men and boys marching across the desert in separate groups one after another, each group led by a man holding a tall banner of a different plain color with no symbols, donkeys and sheep with them, a white pillar of cloud leading in the sky ahead. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: השבטים נוסעים דגל אחר דגל

en: At a new place beside palm trees in the desert, Hebrew men with beards raising tall golden boards upright and stretching embroidered curtains over them to set up a holy tent again, while around them other men and boys pitch small tents and unload donkeys. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: מקימים את המשכן וחונים

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing in front of a newly finished beautiful holy tent with a white curtain fence, pouring golden oil from a small horn onto a copper altar, a white cloud resting above the tent, bright morning.
caption: משה מסים להקים את המשכן

en: Twelve dignified tribal leaders with beards and fine colorful robes arriving in front of a holy tent, leading six covered wooden wagons each pulled by two oxen, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe watching them come.
caption: הנשיאים מביאים עגלות ושורים

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe handing the rope of two oxen harnessed to an empty covered wooden wagon to a group of strong bearded men in simple robes who receive it gladly, more empty wagons with oxen waiting in a row behind.
caption: משה נותן את העגלות ללוים

en: Strong bearded Hebrew men lifting tall heavy golden wooden boards and rolled curtains and loading them onto wooden wagons harnessed to oxen in the desert, working together. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: הלוים מעמיסים קרשים על העגלות

en: One dignified tribal leader with a black beard and a royal purple robe walking alone toward a copper altar in front of a holy tent, carrying a large silver bowl in his hands, behind him helpers leading one bull, one ram and one lamb, a priest in white waiting at the altar.
caption: נשיא יהודה מביא קרבן ראשון

en: Twelve dignified tribal leaders with beards standing in a half circle around a copper altar with a small fire, on the ground before the altar twelve shining silver bowls and twelve small golden spoons arranged in neat rows, a holy tent behind, festive joyful mood.
caption: שנים עשר נשיאים הביאו: המזבח חנוך

en: A small group of four sad Hebrew men with beards standing apart at the edge of a desert camp with heads lowered, while in the camp behind them happy families of men and boys sit around small fires roasting lambs and celebrating. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אנשים לא יכלו להקריב פסח ועצובים

en: Four Hebrew men with beards standing before Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban, pleading with open hands and asking a question, Moses listening kindly with attention, desert camp tents behind.
caption: באים אל משה: למה נגרע?

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing alone at the entrance of a holy tent with his head bowed and hands open, a white cloud resting on top of the tent and soft light shining from inside, the four men waiting far away in the background.
caption: משה שואל את ה'

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe coming out with a wide smile and open arms toward four Hebrew men with beards who are now jumping with joy and raising their hands happily, a holy tent with a white cloud behind him.
caption: משה מבשר: יש פסח שני

en: Four happy Hebrew men with beards bringing a white lamb to a copper altar in the courtyard of a holy tent, a priest in a white robe and white turban receiving them, a thin crescent moon faintly visible in the afternoon sky.
caption: אחרי חדש מקריבים את הפסח

en: Evening: four happy Hebrew men with beards and their sons sitting together on mats at the entrance of a tent, eating roasted meat with round flat unleavened breads and green bitter lettuce leaves from wooden plates, a full moon in the sky, a small fire. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אוכלים עם מצות ומרורים

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing in the desert camp and pointing toward distant green mountains, twelve men with walking sticks and travel bags standing in a row before him ready to go, tents behind.
caption: משה שולח שנים עשר מרגלים

en: Twelve travelers with walking sticks, seen from behind, standing on a hilltop and looking down at a rich green land: big stone walled cities, vineyards, fruit trees and golden fields in a wide valley.
caption: המרגלים רואים את הארץ

en: In a vineyard, two Hebrew men with beards cutting an enormous bunch of purple grapes, as big as a man, from a thick vine with a knife, a third man holding the giant bunch from below, another holding huge pomegranates and figs.
caption: כורתים אשכול ענבים ענק

en: Men walking into a desert camp carrying one enormous bunch of purple grapes hanging from a long wooden pole on their shoulders, others carrying giant pomegranates and figs, showing them to Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe while a crowd of amazed men and boys gathers around. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חוזרים ומראים את הפרות

en: Night in the desert camp: a group of ten men with frightened faces waving their arms and speaking fearfully to a big crowd, the men and boys in the crowd crying, holding their heads and wiping tears, tents and torches around. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: עשרה מרגלים מפחידים, והעם בוכה

en: Two brave men standing on a rock in front of a crowd in the desert camp, one with a short black beard and a red-brown robe, one with a brown beard and a green robe, speaking with confident smiles and pointing with raised arms toward distant green mountains, bright sunrise. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: כלב ויהושע: טובה הארץ מאד מאד

en: Korach, an angry rich man with a long black beard and a fancy striped blue robe, standing at the head of a group of men and arguing loudly with a pointing finger at Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe, who answers calmly and humbly, desert camp tents behind.
caption: קרח מתוכח עם משה

en: Twelve dignified tribal leaders with beards standing in a line, each one holding out a plain dry wooden staff and handing it to Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe, who already holds several staffs in his arm.
caption: כל נשיא מביא מטה

en: Evening inside a holy tent with embroidered curtains: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe carefully laying twelve plain dry wooden staffs side by side in a neat row on the floor, an oil lamp stand glowing softly beside him.
caption: משה מניח את המטות באהל מועד

en: Sunrise in the desert: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe seen from behind, pulling aside the curtain at the entrance of a holy tent to walk in, a crowd of curious tribal leaders and men waiting outside at a distance and watching eagerly.
caption: בבקר משה נכנס לאהל

en: Close view on the floor of a holy tent: twelve wooden staffs lying side by side in a row, eleven of them plain and dry, and one in the middle covered with fresh green leaves and beautiful white and pink blossoms. No people.
caption: מטה אהרן פרח

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing outside a holy tent holding up high a wooden staff that has green leaves, blossoms and ripe almonds growing on it, Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban standing humbly beside him, the amazed tribal leaders each holding his own plain dry staff and loo
caption: על המטה שקדים, וכלם רואים

en: Thirsty Hebrew men and boys in a hot dry desert camp under a burning sun, turning their empty clay jugs and leather water bags upside down with not a drop coming out, a dry empty stone well, tired thirsty sheep and donkeys. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אין מים, והעם צמא

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban kneeling side by side with bowed heads at the entrance of a holy tent, praying, a white cloud resting above the tent and soft light shining on them.
caption: משה ואהרן מתפללים

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe inside a holy tent with embroidered curtains, reaching out with both hands and lifting a special long wooden staff from its place beside a golden lamp stand.
caption: משה לוקח את המטה

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe holding a wooden staff and Aaron, an old man with a grey beard wearing a white priestly robe and a white turban standing in front of one huge dry grey rock in the desert, a big crowd of thirsty men and boys with empty jugs gathered in a half circle facing the rock and waiting. Only men and boys in the pict
caption: מקהילים את העם מול הסלע

en: A great stream of clear blue water bursting out of a huge grey desert rock and flowing over the sand like a river, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing beside the rock holding his wooden staff, the crowd of men and boys cheering with raised arms. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: מים רבים יוצאים מן הסלע

en: Happy Hebrew men and boys kneeling beside a clear stream flowing through the desert, drinking from their cupped hands and filling clay jugs, sheep, cows and donkeys drinking from the water next to them, a big rock in the background. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: העם והבהמות שותים

en: Balak, a king with a golden crown, a red beard and a red royal cloak, standing on top of a stone city wall with a worried frightened face, looking down at an enormous camp of thousands of tents filling the whole plain below.
caption: בלק רואה את ישראל ומפחד

en: Balak, a king with a golden crown, a red beard and a red royal cloak, sitting on a throne and sending out three messengers in fine robes who carry small chests full of gold coins and lead camels out of the palace gate.
caption: בלק שולח שליחים אל בלעם

en: Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, riding on a grey donkey along a country road, two servant youths walking behind him, hills and vineyards around, morning.
caption: בלעם רוכב על האתון

en: A grey donkey lying down flat on its belly on a narrow path between two low stone vineyard walls and refusing to move, Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, standing next to it angry and confused with a stick in his hand. Nothing else on the path.
caption: האתון רובצת בדרך

en: On a high mountain top, seven small stone altars standing in one row, workers placing the last stones, Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, and a king with a golden crown and a red beard standing beside them, far below in the valley a huge camp of tents.
caption: בונים שבעה מזבחות

en: Balaam, a foreign sorcerer with a pointed grey beard, a dark purple robe and a tall pointed hat, standing on a mountain top with both arms spread wide and a surprised gentle smile, looking down at a beautiful orderly camp of tents in the valley glowing in golden light, beside him a king with a golden crown and a red beard clapping his hands in anger.
caption: בלעם רוצה לקלל ומברך: מה טבו

en: Three plastic toy building-brick doll figures, blocky toy minifigures with round yellow plastic heads, simple painted smiling faces, stiff plastic arms and claw hands, with long plastic toy hair pieces completely flat plain rectangular brick torsos with no body shape at all, long sleeves and a high neckline, and long plain orange and purple toy dresses, standing beside colorful market tents full o
caption: בנות מדין מחטיאות את ישראל

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and several old men with white beards standing at the entrance of a holy tent, very sad and crying, covering their faces with their hands, a grey cloudy sky.
caption: משה והזקנים בוכים בפתח אהל מועד

en: Pinchas, a brave young man with a short black beard in a simple white robe, rising up with determination from among a seated crowd of sad men and taking a long spear in his hand, standing tall and brave, the others looking up at him. No fighting, no blood. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: פינחס קם ולוקח רמח בידו

en: The desert camp after a hard time: the dark grey clouds parting and bright warm sunshine breaking through over the tents, weak tired men and boys getting up from their mats, helping each other stand and smiling with relief. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: המגפה נעצרת

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe placing a white priestly turban on the head of a young man with a short black beard who now wears a white priestly robe with a colorful sash, an old priest with a grey beard smiling beside them, a holy tent behind, peaceful sunny day.
caption: פינחס מקבל ברית שלום ונהיה כהן

en: A young priest with a short black beard in a white robe and white turban walking at the head of an army of Hebrew men with round shields and spears, blowing a long straight silver trumpet, banners of plain colors behind him, marching out of the desert camp. No fighting, no blood.
caption: פינחס יוצא למלחמה במדין עם החצוצרות

en: Two Hebrew shepherds with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, standing in the dry desert surrounded by enormous flocks of sheep, goats and cows that fill the whole picture, very little grass on the ground.
caption: לראובן ולגד עדרים גדולים

en: Two Hebrew shepherds with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, seen from behind on a hill, looking with delight at a wide empty land of rich green meadows and streams below, their sheep beside them.
caption: רואים ארץ טובה למרעה

en: Two Hebrew shepherds with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, holding shepherd crooks and standing respectfully before Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe and a priest in white, asking with open hands and pointing back at green meadows, sheep behind them.
caption: מבקשים ממשה את הארץ

en: Two Hebrew men with beards, one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, now holding round shields and spears, standing before Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe with their right hands on their hearts, making a promise, Moses nodding and agreeing.
caption: מבטיחים: נעבר חלוצים לפני אחינו

en: Hebrew men with beards building low round stone fences for sheep in a green meadow, sheep already inside one finished pen, in the background other men building stone houses and a wall of a small town, boys carrying stones. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: בונים גדרות לצאן וערים

en: Hebrew men with round shields and spears, led by one in a red robe and one in a grey robe, wading first across a shallow blue river, behind them on the river bank a great crowd of men and boys following, green land on the far side. No fighting.
caption: עוברים את הירדן ראשונים

en: A great joyful crowd of Hebrew men and boys with bundles on their shoulders, donkeys and sheep walking out on a road away from big pyramids and palm trees in the background, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe leading with a staff, sunrise. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: יוצאים ממצרים

en: A great crowd of Hebrew men and boys walking on a dry sandy path through the middle of a sea, two towering walls of blue water with fish standing on both sides, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe holding up his staff. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: עוברים בים סוף

en: A beautiful green desert oasis with many tall date palm trees and twelve small round springs of clear blue water, Hebrew men and boys resting in the shade, drinking and filling jugs, tents among the palms. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אילם: שתים עשרה עינות ושבעים תמרים

en: A huge camp of tents spread on a desert plain facing one tall rocky mountain whose top is covered with thick cloud and bright light, the lower slopes of the mountain covered with green grass and flowers, men and boys standing and looking at the mountain. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חונים מול הר סיני

en: A long line of Hebrew men and boys with camels and donkeys walking over endless yellow sand dunes, a tall white pillar of cloud leading them in the sky, a covered chest carried on poles at the front, hot sun. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: הולכים במדבר ארבעים שנה

en: A huge camp of tents on a green plain beside a blue river, across the river a stone walled city surrounded by palm trees, Hebrew men and boys standing on the river bank looking happily across at the green land beyond. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חונים בערבות מואב מול יריחו

en: A huge crowd of Hebrew men and boys with donkeys, sheep and bundles walking away from a tall rocky desert mountain behind them, Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe leading at the front with a wooden staff, morning light. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: יוצאים מהר סיני

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing on a low rock and placing his hand on the shoulder of one of several wise older bearded men standing in a row before him, appointing them as helpers, desert camp tents behind, people watching. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: ממנים שופטים לעזר למשה

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe pointing toward distant green hills while twelve men with walking sticks and small travel bags set out on a path toward the hills, seen from behind, desert camp at the side.
caption: שולחים מרגלים לארץ

en: A very long winding line of Hebrew men and boys with camels, donkeys and sheep walking across wide yellow sand dunes, the path curving in big loops around a brown mountain range, a tall white pillar of cloud ahead of them, hot sun. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: הולכים במדבר ארבעים שנה

en: Hebrew men with round shields and spears cheering with raised arms in front of a big stone walled city whose gates stand open, a fallen enormous iron crown and a giant empty iron bed lying beside the gate, no fighting, no blood, joyful victory.
caption: מנצחים את סיחון ועוג

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe pointing with an open hand over wide green pasture land beside a blue river, two happy bearded shepherds standing next to him with very large flocks of sheep and cows grazing all over the meadows.
caption: ראובן וגד מקבלים נחלה

en: Close view of a Hebrew man with a brown beard, wrapped in a white prayer shawl with dark stripes, covering his eyes with his right hand while praying with deep devotion at sunrise, golden morning light, a small boy beside him also covering his eyes with his hand.
caption: שמע ישראל ה' אחד

en: Inside a simple stone house, a Hebrew father with a beard sitting at a wooden table with his two young sons, an open scroll with blank parchment on the table, the father pointing at the scroll and teaching, the boys listening eagerly, oil lamp on the table.
caption: ושננתם לבניך: אבא מלמד תורה

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his young son walking side by side along a country dirt road between olive trees and hills, a donkey carrying sacks next to them, the father talking and gesturing as he teaches, the boy looking up at him, sunny day.
caption: ובלכתך בדרך: לומדים גם בדרך

en: Night time in a cozy room: a small boy lying in his bed under a blanket covering his eyes with his hand, his father with a beard sitting on the edge of the bed next to him, a window with moon and stars, a small oil lamp glowing.
caption: ובשכבך: קריאת שמע לפני השנה

en: A Hebrew man with a beard wearing a white prayer shawl, a small black leather box on his forehead held by a black strap, carefully winding a black leather strap around his bare left forearm with a small black box on the upper arm, morning light, calm and focused.
caption: וקשרתם: מניחים תפלין

en: A Hebrew father with a beard lifting his little son up to the doorpost of their stone house so the boy can touch with his fingertips a tiny slim wooden case, only as long as a hand and as thin as two fingers, fixed diagonally high on the right doorpost, open wooden door, flowers by the entrance, sunny.
caption: וכתבתם: מזוזה בפתח

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard walking behind two brown oxen that pull a simple wooden plow, cutting straight furrows in bare brown soil, an empty brown field all around, hills in the distance, early morning.
caption: חורשים את השדה

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard walking along the furrows of a plowed brown field, scattering golden grain seeds from a cloth bag hanging on his shoulder with a wide swing of his arm, a small boy with a little bag helping, birds in the sky.
caption: זורעים חטה

en: Gentle rain falling from grey clouds on a field where rows of small fresh green sprouts are coming up from the brown soil, puddles between the rows, a farmer and his boy standing under a tree smiling and holding out their hands to feel the rain.
caption: ה' נותן גשם בעתו

en: A wide field of tall golden ripe wheat under a bright sun, Hebrew farmers with beards cutting the wheat with sickles and tying it into big golden sheaves, boys carrying sheaves to a pile. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: קוצרים את החטה

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his three sons sitting around a wooden table, each one holding and biting a piece of fresh round bread, a big basket full of bread loaves, olives and a jug of water on the table, everyone eating happily.
caption: אוכלים לחם ושבעים

en: After the meal: a Hebrew father with a beard and his three sons sitting at a wooden table with empty plates and only crumbs left, all of them with eyes closed and faces lifted up, hands held together on their chests in thankful prayer, warm golden light coming through the window.
caption: מברכים ברכת המזון

en: Spring time with blossoming almond trees: a Hebrew father with a beard and his sons walking up to the gate of a great golden stone temple, the father carrying a white lamb on his shoulders, other families of men and boys walking with lambs too. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: פסח: מקריבים קרבן פסח

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons sitting around a low table, eating round flat thin unleavened breads, a tall stack of the flat round breads on the table, spring flowers seen through the window, in the corner a small clay oven with flat breads baking.
caption: אוכלים מצות שבעה ימים

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard cutting the very first sheaf of green-golden barley with a sickle at the edge of a field that is still standing uncut, beside him his young son counting on his fingers, and a row of seven small stones laid on a flat rock.
caption: סופרים שבעה שבועות מתחלת הקציר

en: Early summer: a joyful Hebrew father and his sons standing in a golden stone temple courtyard, the father holding two large loaves of bread on a tray, the boys holding baskets of wheat sheaves decorated with flowers, other men rejoicing around. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חג השבועות: שמחים לפני ה'

en: Autumn: Hebrew farmers with beards on a round stone threshing floor shoveling big heaps of golden grain into sacks, boys treading purple grapes in a stone wine press beside it, donkeys loaded with full sacks, leaves turning yellow. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אוספים את התבואה מן הגרן

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons sitting happily inside a booth made of wooden poles with a roof of green palm branches, fruits hanging from the roof, the father holding a tall green palm branch and a yellow citron fruit, more booths in the background, golden city behind. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חג הסכות: ושמחת בחגך

en: Two Hebrew men with beards arguing in a village street, each one holding one end of the rope of the same brown goat standing between them and pulling it toward himself, upset faces, a few boys watching from the side.
caption: שני אנשים רבים

en: Two Hebrew men with beards walking together with a brown goat toward a big stone city gate, where a wise old judge with a long white beard sits on a stone bench in the shade of the gate, an officer with a wooden staff standing beside him.
caption: הולכים אל השופט בשער העיר

en: At the stone city gate, two serious men standing side by side in front of a seated old judge with a long white beard, one of them raising his hand as he speaks and tells what he saw, the judge listening very carefully with his hand on his beard.
caption: שני עדים מספרים מה ראו

en: A wise old judge with a long white beard sitting on a stone bench, turning his head away and holding up his open palm in a clear refusing gesture, while a man in rich clothes holds out a leather bag overflowing with gold coins toward him.
caption: השופט לא לוקח שחד

en: A wise old judge with a long white beard standing up at the city gate, with one hand holding a brass balance scale with two perfectly even pans, with the other hand pointing to one of two men, who is happily receiving the rope of the brown goat.
caption: השופט פוסק בצדק

en: Two Hebrew men with beards shaking hands warmly and smiling at each other in front of the stone city gate, the brown goat standing calmly beside one of them, the old judge with a white beard smiling in the background.
caption: עושים שלום

en: A little white lamb running away alone over a green hill toward a forest, while far behind it a flock of sheep grazes and a shepherd with a beard sits under a tree facing the other way and does not notice.
caption: כבש בורח מן העדר

en: A kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe, walking on a path between trees with a bundle of wood on his back, stopping surprised as he finds a little white lamb standing alone and lost among the bushes.
caption: איש מוצא את הכבש

en: A kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe carrying a little white lamb in his arms through the open wooden gate of the yard of his small stone house, his young son running out of the door to greet them.
caption: מביא אותו אל ביתו

en: In the yard of a small stone house, a kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe kneeling and feeding a little white lamb fresh green grass from his hand, his young son putting down a bowl of water, a small straw shelter beside them.
caption: מאכיל אותו ושומר עליו

en: A worried shepherd with a grey beard and a brown robe, holding a shepherd's crook, walking along a village path and shading his eyes with his hand as he searches in every direction, looking behind bushes and stone fences.
caption: הרועה מחפש את הכבש

en: A kind Hebrew man with a short black beard and a blue robe handing a little white lamb into the open arms of a very happy shepherd with a grey beard and a brown robe holding a crook, both smiling widely, a young boy clapping beside them, stone house behind.
caption: השבת אבדה: מחזיר בשמחה

en: Close view of a fig tree branch with big green leaves and one single first ripe purple fig, a Hebrew farmer with a beard looking at it with delight and pointing at it, his orchard behind him, morning sun.
caption: תאנה ראשונה על העץ

en: Close view of the hands of a Hebrew farmer with a beard tying a thin red thread around the stem of a ripe purple fig still growing on the fig tree, big green leaves around, a small boy watching closely.
caption: קושרים עליה חוט לסימן

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard and his son placing beautiful first fruits into a woven basket decorated with green leaves: purple figs, bunches of grapes, red pomegranates, dates and olives, sitting in their orchard.
caption: שמים את הבכורים בסל

en: A joyful procession of Hebrew farmers and boys walking up a road toward a golden city on a hill, each carrying a basket of fruit on his shoulder, in front an ox with gilded horns and a wreath of olive leaves on its head, a man playing a flute. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: עולים לירושלים

en: In a bright stone courtyard, a Hebrew farmer with a beard handing a woven basket full of figs, grapes and pomegranates to a priest in a white robe and white turban who receives it with both hands, a stone altar in the background.
caption: נותנים את הסל לכהן

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard and his sons standing in a bright stone courtyard with arms raised high in joyful thanks and faces lifted toward the bright sky, a basket of fruit resting on the ground beside a stone altar, other men rejoicing and singing around. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: מודים לה' ושמחים

en: Sad Hebrew men and boys sitting on the bank of a wide river in a faraway foreign land, strange tall brick towers of a foreign city behind them, their small harps hanging on willow trees, looking with longing toward the far horizon. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: עם ישראל רחוק, בגלות

en: Hebrew men and boys standing close together in an open field in a foreign land, praying with deep feeling, eyes closed, hands on their hearts, faces lifted toward a bright sky with sun rays breaking through the clouds. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: שבים אל ה' בכל הלב

en: View from above of four long lines of Hebrew men and boys coming from four different directions and meeting at one crossroads: one line with camels from the desert, one from snowy mountains, one coming off wooden sailing ships at the shore, one from a forest. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: ה' מקבץ אותנו מכל הארצות

en: Happy Hebrew men and boys with bundles on their backs arriving at the top of a hill and seeing a beautiful green land with a golden city in front of them, one man kneeling and kissing the ground, others raising their arms with joy. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חוזרים לארץ ישראל

en: Rich orchards and fields in a sunny green land: trees heavy with red pomegranates, figs and olives, vines full of purple grapes, golden wheat, Hebrew men and boys picking fruit into overflowing baskets, sheep grazing. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: הארץ נותנת פרות

en: Hebrew men and boys dancing joyfully in a big circle with hands on each other's shoulders in the square of a golden stone city, one bearded man in the middle hugging a scroll wrapped in a blue velvet cover, bright sunny sky. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: שמחים ואוהבים את ה'

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe walking with a wooden staff from tent to tent through the desert camp, speaking kindly to groups of men and boys who gather around him and listen with love and respect. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: משה בן מאה ועשרים שנה

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing face to face with Joshua, a strong younger man with a short black beard and a red-brown robe, holding both of Joshua's shoulders firmly and encouraging him, a large crowd of men and boys watching. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חזק ואמץ: משה מחזק את יהושע

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe sitting alone inside a tent at a low wooden table, writing with a feather quill on a long parchment scroll that is seen only from the back side so no writing is visible, a small ink pot and an oil lamp beside him.
caption: משה כותב את התורה

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe handing a large rolled scroll with two wooden handles to three priests in white robes and white turbans who stretch out both hands to receive it with great respect, elders with grey beards standing around.
caption: משה נותן את התורה לכהנים

en: Inside a holy tent with embroidered curtains, two priests in white robes and white turbans carefully placing a large rolled scroll on a small shelf at the side of a golden chest that is completely covered with a blue cloth and has two long golden carrying poles. Soft golden light.
caption: שמים את התורה ליד הארון

en: A king with a golden crown and a brown beard standing on a high wooden platform in a huge stone courtyard, holding an open scroll seen from behind and reading aloud, an enormous crowd of men, boys and babies held in their fathers' arms listening, green booths covered with palm branches at the sides. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: הקהל: כלם באים לשמע תורה

en: A big brown eagle landing on a high rocky cliff ledge with a long branch in its beak, adding it to a half-built nest made of sticks and twigs, blue sky and mountains behind. No people.
caption: הנשר בונה קן

en: A finished round nest of sticks on a high rocky cliff ledge with three large white eggs lying in it, a big brown eagle standing beside the nest and looking at the eggs, blue sky and mountains behind. No people.
caption: ביצים בקן

en: Close view of a nest of sticks on a high cliff: three tiny fluffy white eagle chicks just hatched, broken white eggshell pieces around them, one chick still half inside its cracked shell, a big brown eagle watching them gently. No people.
caption: הגוזלים בוקעים

en: A big brown eagle standing on the edge of its nest on a high cliff, bending down and feeding three fluffy grey eagle chicks that stretch up with wide open beaks, a small fish held in the eagle's beak. No people.
caption: הנשר מאכיל את גוזליו

en: A big brown eagle standing over its nest on a high cliff with both huge wings spread wide open like a roof above three young eagle chicks, sheltering them from rain and wind, dark rain clouds in the sky. No people.
caption: הנשר פורש כנפיו ושומר עליהם

en: A big brown eagle flying high in a bright blue sky above mountains and clouds with its huge wings spread, three young eagle chicks riding safely on its back between the wings, sunshine. No people.
caption: נושא אותם על כנפיו: כך ה' שומר עלינו

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing on a rock with both hands raised and spread out in blessing over twelve groups of men and boys standing in front of him, each group under its own tribal banner of a different plain color with no symbols. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: משה מברך את השבטים

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe seen from behind, climbing alone with a wooden staff up a steep rocky mountain path, far below him the desert camp of tents and tiny people looking up, late afternoon light.
caption: משה עולה אל הר נבו

en: Moses, a tall man with a dark brown beard, a white cloth head covering and a long light robe standing on the top of a high mountain, seen from behind, looking out over a wide beautiful green land below: a blue river, a city of palm trees, green hills, a sea far away, bright clear sky.
caption: משה רואה את כל הארץ

en: Sunset behind a high mountain, in the valley below a desert camp of tents where Hebrew men and boys sit on the ground sad and crying, wiping tears, some with heads bowed, all facing the mountain. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: כל ישראל בוכים שלשים יום

en: Joshua, a strong man with a short black beard and a red-brown robe, standing confidently at the head of a great crowd of Hebrew men and boys, pointing forward toward a river and green land beyond it, the people following him willingly. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: יהושע מנהיג את העם

en: A joyful celebration: Hebrew men and boys dancing in a circle, several bearded men holding scrolls dressed in velvet covers of red, blue and green with silver crowns on top, boys waving small plain colored flags, warm lamp light. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: מסימים את התורה ומתחילים מחדש
